newsitem.title: USA: Summers sees US '97 budget gap well below forecast.
newsitem.headline: Summers sees US '97 budget gap well below forecast.

text.p: The U.S. budget deficit in the current fiscal year looks likely to come in significantly below the administration's forecast of $126 billion, Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said on Thursday.
"On available evidence the budget is likely to come in substantially under forecast," he told the Senate Finance Committee.
Summers told reporters later that the expected improvement in the budget deficit for the current fiscal year that ends on September 30 was due to faster economic growth and higher government revenue.
"The economy has been strong and revenue collections have come in well," he said. He said that revenues were well ahead of what would be expected even with the faster growth.
